title: Ice Age Sahara as origin of Egyptian civilization

tellings.quote: I think if we want to get into the origins of ancient Egyptian civilization, we're going to have to start looking at what the Sahara was doing during the Ice Age.

plain: A writer on ancient history named Graham Hancock says that to find where ancient Egyptian civilization really began, we need to look at the Sahara Desert during the Ice Age, many thousands of years ago, when it was not the desert it is today. If he is right, Egypt would have grown out of an older, forgotten culture that once lived in what is now the Sahara.
